name: octogee-workspace-api
description: Octogee workspace API — consolidated HTTP service (ex Cloud Functions)

scripts.build: tsc && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.json && npm run verify:no-alias-leakage
scripts.verify:no-alias-leakage: ! grep -rq --include='*.js' '@shared' dist/ || (echo '❌ Found un-rewritten @shared/* alias in compiled JS. Fix: ensure tsc-alias is installed and the build script runs `tsc && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.json` (path alias rewriting must run after emit, or Node will fail at runtime with MODULE_NOT_FOUND).' && exit 1)
